Terminals use a directory independent of conversations by default. A directory selected in Files applies only to a new terminal. Shares the app UID. The default lease is two hours; detached terminals are reclaimed after 30 minutes of inactivity.

An app update or device restart ended the old terminal. Its command outcome is unknown. Close it to free a slot, then start a new terminal. Commands will not be replayed; workspace files are retained.

The old process state is unknown. It cannot be attached or replayed. Refresh, start an independent terminal when capacity remains, if all slots are occupied, reboot the device then close old terminals while retaining app data. Clearing the display does not stop processes.

No conversation needs to be created or selected. Opening the page connects to a retained terminal; first entry creates one if none exists. The bundled Linux environment is prepared on first start. Maintenance is under Terminal options → Execution environments.

Terminals and Agent tasks can run together. An open terminal or uncollected result does not block other tasks. Shared files can change concurrently; verify the final result. Only environment maintenance, engine capacity and input to the same terminal require coordination. Leaving detaches without stopping commands.
Terminal stopped. Select Close terminal to free a terminal slot.
